messages:
Leila M: Heads-up — planning a percent+region canary for model-v6 next week. Thinking small initial slices: 5% eu-west-1, 2% us-east-1. Need sign-off on flag shape and kill-switch semantics.
Samir: sounds fine. can we make the percent configurable per region in the flag store?
Leila M: yes — config per-region is the plan. also want automatic fallback to v5 if latency or error rate spikes.
Anya R: guarding notes: add a hard kill_switch boolean that ops can flip, plus baked in checks for p95 latency (+30% from baseline) and 5xx rate > 0.5%. Put alerts to #eng-oncall and page SRE-Oncall.
Mike W: I'll open a tiny PR for the flag and the rollout job. sketch of config in the PR description:```yaml
feature_flags:
  model_v6_canary:
    regions:
      - name: eu-west-1
        percent: 5
      - name: us-east-1
        percent: 2
    kill_switch: true
    metrics:
      - latency_p95
      - error_rate_5xx
    thresholds:
      latency_p95: 1.3   # 1.3x baseline
      error_rate_5xx: 0.005  # 0.5%
```
Mike W: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-platform/pull/4821 :eyes:
DeployBot: deploy pipeline queued for feature/flags/model-v6-canary — test namespace creation ok.
Samir: quick Q — can we scope a tiny internal-test audience (prod employees) for initial smoke before region ramp?
Leila M: good call — add an audience tag `internal_team:true` that maps to a small user segment, yes. will include in PR.
SRE-Oncall: please make sure alerts include a short remediation playbook in the alert text (what to toggle, how to rollback). Also include the rollback runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/canary-rollback
Anya R: agree. also add a short TTL for canary membership so overlap doesn't accumulate during multi-day ramps.
Leila M: plan: Monday 10:00UTC start; internal+eu 5% baseline for 2 hours smoke, then wait for green signals, then add us-east 2% and continue staged percent increases per 24h windows. if any threshold trips -> auto-failover to v5 and page SRE.
Samir: 👍 will review the PR now. ping me for code review if you want a quick pair.
Mike W: thanks — I'll tag you. final checklist I'll include in the PR body: flag shape, kill-switch, metrics hookup, alert text + runbook link, internal audience, TTL for audiences.
Leila M: perfect. tagging @SRE-Oncall for awareness. will post the final rollout schedule here once PR merges. :shipit:
